page.layout: One digitiser's cover sheet: e-rara logo at top right, website and title block centred, rule lines with multilingual access and terms-of-use text below, Visual Library logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. It shows the e-rara.ch logo and banner, the digitised record (title "Dissertatio philologica in historiam miraculosi transitus Israelitarum per Mare Rubrum", author Rodolph, Johann Rudolph, "[Bernae], 1679", Universitätsbibliothek Bern), a persistent link, and terms of use in German, English, French and Italian. None of this is printed text of the book, so it is left out. The title and imprint are given here only for identification: Dissertatio philologica in historiam miraculosi transitus Israelitarum per Mare Rubrum; Rodolph, Johann Rudolph; [Bernae], 1679.
